last_action: L4.S11 STRUCTURAL metric reformulation + S11c retry + REVERT. Part A: rewrote adv_resistance in src/bin/research.rs from divergence (1 - |f_clean - f_adv|/(f_clean+0.05)) to absolute ((1 - f_adv_sub/0.15).clamp(0,1)). Rationale: old formula mechanically punished any clean-only improvement by widening clean-adv divergence (L4.S9 post-mortem). New formula measures absolute adversarial robustness — production semantics. Build clean, L3 spot-check 0.006434. Part B: 15-run L4.S11-baseline 0.169076 std 0.012458 (new metric — NOT comparable to old-metric 0.096517). adv_resistance 0.9571->0.2945 as expected (old formula was inflating resistance via divergence=0). All deterministic clean-pass metrics byte-identical to L4.S7. Commit e885705. Part C L4.S11c: per-pass int_threshold (clean=0.12, adv=0.10) under new metric. 15-run fitness 0.169076->0.182168 (+0.013, REGRESSION, fails 0.015 threshold and is a net loss). Per-pass int_threshold is DEAD under both old and new adv formulas — the new metric unblocks the formula, but fitness_adv_sub has a dominant speed component that inherits jitter from the preceding clean pass. REVERTED. L3 spot-check 0.006674. Commit ceed159. Baseline fitness now 0.169076 under new metric (cross-epoch incomparable to 0.096517). NEW DEAD: per_pass_interference_threshold_speed_coupled_adv_sub_structural. Part D SKIPPED (gated on C landing). Structural residual: speed jitter in adv pass — future structural probe is warm-up+median-of-k speed measurement or dropping speed from fitness_adv_sub.
